messages: You make ordinary days feel like a celebration.
Your laugh is the kind of music a room remembers.
Thank you for the way you show up for the people you love.
May this year be gentle, bright, and wildly yours.
letter: Sami, I keep thinking about the way you walk into a room and the air changes, as if everyone had been waiting for you without knowing it. This letter is a small attempt to catch that feeling on paper. I remember late conversations, shared jokes that still echo, and the quiet kindness you offer when nobody is watching. You are allowed to rest. You are allowed to want more. You are allowed to take up space with your whole heart. Happy birthday. May you feel celebrated on purpose, not as a courtesy. I hope cake tastes better this year, that photos look like proof, and that every wish you pop open finds you. With love, always, from someone who is glad you exist in this world today and every day after.
wishes: A year that feels like sunlight on your face.
A trip you talk about for decades.
A quiet morning with excellent coffee.
A project that makes you proud.
A wish you have not named yet.
